caption: The drawing consists of eighteen rectangular swatches arranged in three rows against an off-white background. Each swatch displays a different textile or fabric pattern. The top row contains seven swatches with small, closely packed designs, mostly in colors such as black, red, beige, and brown; the patterns vary and include floral motifs, geometric shapes, stripes, and dots. The second row has six swatches displaying larger motifs and slightly more open compositions in shades of beige, pink, red, purple, and black, with patterns including abstract shapes, dots, floral forms, and wavy lines. The bottom row contains five swatches, each larger in size, representing more detailed patterns, including interlocking shapes, scattered flowers, leaves, circular motifs, and dot clusters, mainly in shades of purple, pink, red, and beige. The entire composition is set on a plain, faded background with some visible discoloration near the bottom edge. Each swatch is numbered in small type below the pattern.
title: Printed Cottons
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
